---
title: "Second Calls and Mutual Aid"
format: pdf
---
```{r, message = F}
# load in packages and data
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
second_aid <- read_csv("second_shift_aid.csv")

# create seasons col and levels for days and seasons for plots
days <- c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
seasons <- c("Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter")
second_aid <- second_aid |>
  mutate(`Incident Date` = mdy(`Incident Date`),
         `Incident Day Name` = factor(`Incident Day Name`, levels = days),
         Season = case_when(month(`Incident Date`) %in% c(12, 01, 02) ~ "Winter",
                            month(`Incident Date`) %in% c(03, 04, 05) ~ "Spring",
                            month(`Incident Date`) %in% c(06, 07, 08) ~ "Summer",
                            month(`Incident Date`) %in% c(09, 10, 11) ~ "Fall")) |>
  mutate(Season = factor(Season, levels = seasons))
```

```{r}
# table of capability of unit values
second_aid |>
  count(`Capability of Unit (eResponse.07)`)
# number of mutual aid incidents
mutual_aid_count <- second_aid |>
  filter(`Capability of Unit (eResponse.07)` == "Call Turn Over / Mutual Aid") |>
  nrow()

# table of ems shift values
second_aid |>
  count(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)`)
# number of second call incidents
second_call_count <- second_aid |>
  filter(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` %in% 
           c("No Shift (Second Call)", "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer")) |>
  nrow()

```
The total number of incidents not taken by the scheduled EMS crew from 2021-Present is `r mutual_aid_count + second_call_count`.

```{r}
# explore mysterious A and B entries
check <- second_aid |>
  filter(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "A" | `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "B")

check |>
  head(10)

most_recent_use <- check |>
  pull(`Incident Date`) |>
  max()
```
We were wondering what EMS Shift "A" and "B" were refering to. The last use of them was `r most_recent_use`.

```{r}
# filter to only contain second shift and mutual aid
second_aid_filter <- second_aid |>
  filter(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)" |
          `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call)" |
          `Capability of Unit (eResponse.07)` == "Call Turn Over / Mutual Aid")

# full time series
second_aid_filter |>
  count(period = floor_date(`Incident Date`, "month")) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = period, y = n)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 month", date_labels = "%b %y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Second Call/Mutual Aid Counts"
  )
```

```{r}
# bar dotw
second_aid_filter |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = `Incident Day Name`)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = `Incident Day Name`, label = after_stat(count)),
            stat = "count", vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Counts",
    title = "Second Call/Mutual Aid Counts by Day of the Week"
  )
```

```{r}
# bar season
second_aid_filter |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = Season)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = Season, label = after_stat(count)),
            stat = "count", vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "Counts",
    title = "Second Call/Mutual Aid Counts by Meteorological Season"
  )
```

```{r}
# bar dotw and season
second_aid_filter |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = `Incident Day Name`)) +
  facet_wrap(~Season) +
  geom_text(aes(x = `Incident Day Name`, label = after_stat(count)),
            stat = "count", vjust = 1.5, color = "white") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Second Call/Mutual Aid Counts by Meteorological Season and Day of the Week"
  )
```

```{r}
# bar dotw, season, and year
second_aid_filter |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = `Incident Day Name`)) +
  facet_grid(year(`Incident Date`) ~ Season) +
  geom_text(aes(x = `Incident Day Name`, label = after_stat(count)),
            stat = "count", vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Second Call/Mutual Aid Counts by Meteorological Season, Day of the Week, and Year"
  )

## 13 weeks in a season
```

```{r}
# bar month
second_aid_filter |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = `Incident Day Name`)) +
  facet_wrap(~month(`Incident Date`)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = `Incident Day Name`, label = after_stat(count)),
            stat = "count", vjust = -0.5) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Counts",
    title = "Second Call/Mutual Aid Counts by Day of the Week and Month"
  )
```

```{r}
# 2025-Present
second_aid_filter |>
  filter(year(`Incident Date`) >= 2025) |>
  count(period = floor_date(`Incident Date`, "month")) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = period, y = n)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Second Call/Mutual Aid Counts (2025-Present)"
  )
```

```{r}
# Jun 25 - Oct 25
second_aid_filter |>
  filter(year(`Incident Date`) == 2025 &
           month(`Incident Date`) > 05 &
           month(`Incident Date`) < 11) |>
  count(period = floor_date(`Incident Date`, "day")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 week", date_labels = "%d %b %y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Second Call/Mutual Aid Counts (Jun-Oct 2025)"
  )       
```
